turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've just retired and I'd love to see the country by train. Where would you even start?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: What a lovely plan. Scenic routes through mountains or along the coast are a good place to begin.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm not in a hurry at all.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then slow regional lines are your friend. They stop in small towns, and you can break the journey wherever you like.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, also, We have to pick a moving day and every option has a catch.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: First let me tell you about all of them, then you can comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could go on the last Friday of the month, cheapest van hire, but it's also the busiest day for everyone moving.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a Tuesday in the middle of the month, quiet roads, but we'd have to pay double rent for two weeks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or the bank holiday weekend, both of us are off work, but the removal company charges extra.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the last option, I'm finished. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The Tuesday is calmest, and fewer people moving means fewer hiccups with keys and lifts. If double rent is too much, the bank holiday is next best, since you'll both be there to help.
